summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 3.56/1653)

data.turoyo: Amma malasaf, ənkan d howewo u ʕəlmano aʕmayye, lo kəmxapənwa ah hawne, d kətne šafye, di ǧamaʕa səryayto. D komhalxo bəṯr ad dawsat dab babayḏa aʕ ʕatiqe.
data.translation: But unfortunately, if learning had been with them, they would not have deceived the minds that are pure, of the Syriac community, which walks in the footsteps of its ancient fathers.

rationale: First Infectum-wa for inherited II.1; negative counterfactual apodosis supplies a full contextual example beyond the bare Infectum form.

summary: Jan's English is project machine translation, copied only as supplied and not used to establish senses. All interpretations were checked against the Turoyo.
Kəmxapənwa has plural -ən and -wa in a conditional apodosis after ənkan d howewo. This is Infectum-wa with a counterfactual interpretation, not evidence of habitual repetition.
The inherited Kurdish etymology is retained; one Jan occurrence does not establish a new contact history or another stem.
The minds of a community are the object of deception, a metonymic participant extension of betrügen, not a distinct sense. The characterization belongs to the source speaker.
